"""Tkinter interface for managing students, instructors, and courses."""

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox, filedialog
from part1_oop import Student, Instructor, Course, save_data, load_data
import part4_database as db




[docs]
def main():
    """Start the Tkinter school management application."""
    db.setup_db().close()
    root = tk.Tk(); root.title("School Management System - Tkinter"); root.geometry("1050x680")
    notebook = ttk.Notebook(root); notebook.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=8)
    student_tab, instructor_tab, course_tab, records_tab = [ttk.Frame(notebook) for _ in range(4)]
    for frame, title in zip((student_tab,instructor_tab,course_tab,records_tab),("Students","Instructors","Courses","All Records / Search")): notebook.add(frame,text=title)

    def err(e):
        """Display an error raised by a validation or database operation."""
        messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

    def entries(frame, labels):
        """Create labeled text fields and return their variables by label."""
        out={}
        for r,label in enumerate(labels):
            ttk.Label(frame,text=label).grid(row=r,column=0,sticky="w",padx=5,pady=4); v=tk.StringVar(); ttk.Entry(frame,textvariable=v,width=35).grid(row=r,column=1,padx=5,pady=4); out[label]=v
        return out

    # Students
    sv=entries(student_tab,["Student ID","Name","Age","Email"]); ttk.Label(student_tab,text="Course").grid(row=4,column=0,sticky="w",padx=5,pady=4); student_course=tk.StringVar(); scb=ttk.Combobox(student_tab,textvariable=student_course,state="readonly",width=32); scb.grid(row=4,column=1,padx=5,pady=4)
    stree=ttk.Treeview(student_tab,columns=("id","name","age","email","courses"),show="headings",height=13)
    for c,t,w in (("id","ID",100),("name","Name",160),("age","Age",60),("email","Email",220),("courses","Registered Courses",260)): stree.heading(c,text=t); stree.column(c,width=w)
    stree.grid(row=7,column=0,columnspan=4,sticky="nsew",padx=5,pady=8)
    student_old=[None]

    def refresh():
        """Reload database records and update every table and selector."""
        courses=db.get_courses(); instructors=db.get_instructors();
        scb["values"]=[r[0] for r in courses]; cinst["values"]=[""]+[r[0] for r in instructors]
        for tree in (stree,itree,ctree,alltree):
            for x in tree.get_children(): tree.delete(x)
        for sid,n,a,e in db.get_students(): stree.insert("","end",values=(sid,n,a,e,", ".join(db.get_student_courses(sid))))
        for iid,n,a,e in instructors: itree.insert("","end",values=(iid,n,a,e,", ".join(r[0] for r in courses if r[2]==iid)))
        for cid,n,iid in courses: ctree.insert("","end",values=(cid,n,iid))
        populate_all("")

    def add_student():
        """Validate and add a student, optionally enrolling them in a course."""
        try:
            s=Student(sv["Name"].get(),sv["Age"].get(),sv["Email"].get(),sv["Student ID"].get()); db.add_student_db(s.student_id,s.name,s.age,s.email)
            if student_course.get(): db.enroll_student_db(s.student_id,student_course.get())
            clear_student(); refresh(); messagebox.showinfo("Success","Student added")
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def update_student():
        """Validate and update the selected student."""
        try:
            if not student_old[0]: raise ValueError("Select a student first")
            s=Student(sv["Name"].get(),sv["Age"].get(),sv["Email"].get(),sv["Student ID"].get()); db.update_student_db(student_old[0],s.student_id,s.name,s.age,s.email)
            if student_course.get(): db.enroll_student_db(s.student_id,student_course.get())
            clear_student(); refresh(); messagebox.showinfo("Success","Student updated")
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def delete_student():
        """Delete the selected student from the database."""
        try:
            sid=student_old[0] or sv["Student ID"].get();
            if not sid: raise ValueError("Select a student first")
            db.delete_student_db(sid); clear_student(); refresh()
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def select_student(_=None):
        """Copy the selected student row into the edit fields."""
        if not stree.selection(): return
        vals=stree.item(stree.selection()[0],"values"); student_old[0]=vals[0]
        for k,v in zip(("Student ID","Name","Age","Email"),vals[:4]): sv[k].set(v)
        student_course.set(vals[4].split(", ")[0] if vals[4] else "")

    def clear_student():
        """Clear student fields and remove the current selection."""
        student_old[0]=None
        for v in sv.values(): v.set("")
        student_course.set("")

    stree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>",select_student)
    for col,(txt,cmd) in enumerate((("Add",add_student),("Edit",update_student),("Delete",delete_student),("Clear",clear_student))): ttk.Button(student_tab,text=txt,command=cmd).grid(row=5,column=col,padx=4,pady=6)

    # Instructors
    iv=entries(instructor_tab,["Instructor ID","Name","Age","Email"]); itree=ttk.Treeview(instructor_tab,columns=("id","name","age","email","courses"),show="headings",height=14)
    for c,t,w in (("id","ID",110),("name","Name",170),("age","Age",60),("email","Email",220),("courses","Assigned Courses",270)): itree.heading(c,text=t); itree.column(c,width=w)
    itree.grid(row=6,column=0,columnspan=4,sticky="nsew",padx=5,pady=8); instructor_old=[None]

    def add_instructor():
        """Validate and add an instructor."""
        try:
            i=Instructor(iv["Name"].get(),iv["Age"].get(),iv["Email"].get(),iv["Instructor ID"].get()); db.add_instructor_db(i.instructor_id,i.name,i.age,i.email); clear_instructor(); refresh()
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def update_instructor():
        """Validate and update the selected instructor."""
        try:
            if not instructor_old[0]: raise ValueError("Select an instructor first")
            i=Instructor(iv["Name"].get(),iv["Age"].get(),iv["Email"].get(),iv["Instructor ID"].get()); db.update_instructor_db(instructor_old[0],i.instructor_id,i.name,i.age,i.email); clear_instructor(); refresh()
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def delete_instructor():
        """Delete the selected instructor from the database."""
        try: db.delete_instructor_db(instructor_old[0] or iv["Instructor ID"].get()); clear_instructor(); refresh()
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def select_instructor(_=None):
        """Copy the selected instructor row into the edit fields."""
        if not itree.selection(): return
        vals=itree.item(itree.selection()[0],"values"); instructor_old[0]=vals[0]
        for k,v in zip(("Instructor ID","Name","Age","Email"),vals[:4]): iv[k].set(v)

    def clear_instructor():
        """Clear instructor fields and remove the current selection."""
        instructor_old.__setitem__(0,None); [v.set("") for v in iv.values()]

    itree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>",select_instructor)
    for col,(txt,cmd) in enumerate((("Add",add_instructor),("Edit",update_instructor),("Delete",delete_instructor),("Clear",clear_instructor))): ttk.Button(instructor_tab,text=txt,command=cmd).grid(row=4,column=col,padx=4,pady=6)

    # Courses
    cv=entries(course_tab,["Course ID","Course Name"]); ttk.Label(course_tab,text="Instructor").grid(row=2,column=0,sticky="w",padx=5,pady=4); course_inst=tk.StringVar(); cinst=ttk.Combobox(course_tab,textvariable=course_inst,state="readonly",width=32); cinst.grid(row=2,column=1,padx=5,pady=4)
    ctree=ttk.Treeview(course_tab,columns=("id","name","instructor"),show="headings",height=15)
    for c,t,w in (("id","Course ID",160),("name","Course Name",300),("instructor","Instructor ID",200)): ctree.heading(c,text=t); ctree.column(c,width=w)
    ctree.grid(row=5,column=0,columnspan=4,sticky="nsew",padx=5,pady=8); course_old=[None]

    def add_course():
        """Validate and add a course with its optional instructor."""
        try:
            c=Course(cv["Course ID"].get(),cv["Course Name"].get(),course_inst.get()); db.add_course_db(c.course_id,c.course_name,c.instructor); clear_course(); refresh()
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def update_course():
        """Validate and update the selected course."""
        try:
            if not course_old[0]: raise ValueError("Select a course first")
            c=Course(cv["Course ID"].get(),cv["Course Name"].get(),course_inst.get()); db.update_course_db(course_old[0],c.course_id,c.course_name,c.instructor); clear_course(); refresh()
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def delete_course():
        """Delete the selected course from the database."""
        try: db.delete_course_db(course_old[0] or cv["Course ID"].get()); clear_course(); refresh()
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    def select_course(_=None):
        """Copy the selected course row into the edit fields."""
        if not ctree.selection(): return
        vals=ctree.item(ctree.selection()[0],"values"); course_old[0]=vals[0]; cv["Course ID"].set(vals[0]); cv["Course Name"].set(vals[1]); course_inst.set(vals[2])

    def clear_course():
        """Clear course fields and remove the current selection."""
        course_old.__setitem__(0,None); [v.set("") for v in cv.values()]; course_inst.set("")

    ctree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>",select_course)
    for col,(txt,cmd) in enumerate((("Add",add_course),("Edit",update_course),("Delete",delete_course),("Clear",clear_course))): ttk.Button(course_tab,text=txt,command=cmd).grid(row=3,column=col,padx=4,pady=6)

    # Search / file / backup restore
    search_var=tk.StringVar(); ttk.Label(records_tab,text="Search by name, ID, email, or course:").pack(anchor="w",padx=8,pady=(8,2)); ttk.Entry(records_tab,textvariable=search_var,width=50).pack(anchor="w",padx=8)
    alltree=ttk.Treeview(records_tab,columns=("type","id","name","details"),show="headings",height=18)
    for c,t,w in (("type","Type",100),("id","ID",150),("name","Name / Course",250),("details","Email / Instructor",300)): alltree.heading(c,text=t); alltree.column(c,width=w)
    alltree.pack(fill="both",expand=True,padx=8,pady=8)

    def populate_all(term):
        """Populate the combined records table using an optional search term."""
        for x in alltree.get_children(): alltree.delete(x)
        rows=db.search_records(term) if term else ([ ("Student",r[0],r[1],r[3]) for r in db.get_students()]+[("Instructor",r[0],r[1],r[3]) for r in db.get_instructors()]+[("Course",r[0],r[1],r[2]) for r in db.get_courses()])
        for r in rows: alltree.insert("","end",values=r)

    search_var.trace_add("write",lambda *_: populate_all(search_var.get()))

    def save_json():
        """Save the current database contents to a user-selected JSON file."""
        path=filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension=".json",filetypes=[("JSON","*.json")]);
        if not path:return
        data={"students":[Student(n,a,e,sid,db.get_student_courses(sid)) for sid,n,a,e in db.get_students()],"instructors":[Instructor(n,a,e,iid,[c[0] for c in db.get_courses() if c[2]==iid]) for iid,n,a,e in db.get_instructors()],"courses":[Course(cid,n,iid,[sid for sid,c in db.get_enrollments() if c==cid]) for cid,n,iid in db.get_courses()]}; save_data(data,path); messagebox.showinfo("Saved",path)

    def load_json_gui():
        """Restore database records from a user-selected JSON file."""
        path=filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("JSON","*.json")]);
        if not path:return
        try:
            data=load_data(path)
            with db.connect_db() as conn:
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM enrollments"); conn.execute("DELETE FROM courses"); conn.execute("DELETE FROM instructors"); conn.execute("DELETE FROM students")
            for s in data.get("students",[]): db.add_student_db(s.student_id,s.name,s.age,s.email)
            for i in data.get("instructors",[]): db.add_instructor_db(i.instructor_id,i.name,i.age,i.email)
            for c in data.get("courses",[]): db.add_course_db(c.course_id,c.course_name,c.instructor)
            for s in data.get("students",[]):
                for cid in s.registered_courses: db.enroll_student_db(s.student_id,cid)
            refresh(); messagebox.showinfo("Loaded","JSON data restored")
        except Exception as e: err(e)

    buttons=ttk.Frame(records_tab); buttons.pack(fill="x",padx=8,pady=5)
    for txt,cmd in (("Save JSON",save_json),("Load JSON",load_json_gui),("Backup DB",lambda: messagebox.showinfo("Backup",db.backup_db())),("Restore DB",lambda: (db.restore_db(),refresh(),messagebox.showinfo("Restore","Database restored")))): ttk.Button(buttons,text=txt,command=cmd).pack(side="left",padx=4)
    refresh(); root.mainloop()




if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
